captions.detailed: A countertop bread maker consisting of a softly rounded rectangular main housing, a thick top lid with an integrated dark glass ingredient-dispenser window, a side-mounted black browning selector dial, and a small recessed front control panel. The control panel contains two small grey mode buttons and a lower green start button. The main lid is connected to the back of the housing via a revolute hinge, the browning dial rotates continuously on its horizontal side axis, and the front control buttons act as small prismatic push buttons.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a countertop bread maker with a softly rounded main body, a rear-hinged top lid containing an ingredient dispenser flap, a side-mounted continuous browning dial, and a front control panel with two mode buttons and a start button. Ensure appropriate joints are defined for the lid rotation, dial rotation, and individual button presses.
captions.factory: The code creates the bread maker by first modeling the main casing with a hollowed-out interior baking chamber using CSG operations. A top lid is created as a separate part, filleted, and combined with a glass window cutout. The side browning dial is made of concentric cylinders. The front panel is recessed into the main casing, with small rectangular blocks representing the mode and start buttons. Finally, the parts are assembled using revolute, continuous, and prismatic joints to define the realistic mechanical movements of the lid, dial, and buttons.
